interventions.detail: Used Python 3.12: gdm-xarray-jax v0.1.1 requires >=3.12 although setup.py classifiers list 3.10/3.11
Installed h5py (h5netcdf no longer depends on it) so the sample NetCDF can be read
Downloaded weights and sample data via anonymous HTTPS from storage.googleapis.com/dm_graphcast instead of Colab/GCS client; installed google-cloud-storage
Set attention_type='triblockdiag_mha' on CPU; default splash_mha Pallas kernel fails on CPU backend
Froze resolved package versions into scripts/requirements.lock and pinned repo commit for reproducibility
